excerpt_i18n.zh: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。
excerpt_i18n.en: Model parameter scales keep breaking records, inference costs continue to decline, and the open-source ecosystem is thriving. As model capabilities gradually become industry consensus, a new question emerges: when everyone has access to powerful models, what truly remains as competitive advantage? The answer is shifting—from model capabilities themselves to building scalable intelligent systems around models, and from single-point capability improvements to systems engineering and organization-level deployment capabilities.
excerpt_i18n.es: La escala de los parámetros de los modelos no deja de crecer, los costes de inferencia siguen bajando y el ecosistema de código abierto es cada vez más próspero. Cuando las capacidades de los modelos se convierten gradualmente en un consenso del sector, empieza a surgir una nueva pregunta: cuando todo el mundo puede acceder a potentes capacidades de modelo, ¿qué queda como verdadera ventaja competitiva? La respuesta está pasando de las capacidades del modelo en sí a la construcción de sistemas inteligentes escalables en torno al modelo; de la mejora de capacidades puntuales a la ingeniería de sistemas y la capacidad de implantación a nivel organizativo.

excerpt_i18n.en: (Leiphone) Summary: "Topping the benchmark is just an appetizer; production-grade delivery is the real test." In June 2026, an open-source model named Boogu-Image-0.1 on HuggingFace went viral in the AI community shortly after being uploaded. What made this model stand out was that with a mere 10B parameters, it outperformed many larger models on several key capabilities. Bigger means stronger—long considered an unshakable truth in the AI world, for both language models and image models alike. However, on the Qwen-Image-Bench benchmark, the 10B Boogu-Image-0.1 scored 53.58, ahead of the 20B Qwen-Image-2512 (52.06) and the 80B Hunyuan-Image-3.0 (50.81). Achieving superior performance with parameters only 1/8 or even 1/2 the size of competitors—even if the lead is just a few points—is enough to explain the industry's attention. Of course, benchmark scores are only one aspect of evaluating a model. Compared to benchmark scores, we care more about how far this dark horse model, which punches above its weight, can actually go in real content production workflows. Does its advantage only hold up in benchmarks? Can it quickly generate photorealistic assets and build poster layouts?
